findings.text: the derivation template asserts the dumped module "is byte-identical to the earlier census at revision {previous_receipt_revision}"; the receipt records only a byte count (:918) and the sentence is emitted unconditionally, so it was never measured and it is false — the two dumps are size-equal (219,637,882 B) but differ in 1094 bytes, all before offset 253 KB, beginning at offset 2937 in the HLO Names table with the embedded compiling-checkout name (…msc-marker-census-instrument… vs …msc-marker-census-rebaseline…; sha256 ffca59be3f2c… vs 97cee38e1ea6…), so the sentence should either compare a recorded digest and refuse on mismatch or restate the support as the rule counts both dumps reproduce (120/79 sentinel copies, 122/208 read-body frames).
the committed report ships the same false byte-identity sentence as the derivation's closing support, so the artifact a reader quotes must be corrected with the generator.
the evidence anchor repeats the false byte-identity claim beside the new 120-and-79 baseline, giving the archive a support the dumps themselves falsify.

justifications.durability: tests/test_solve_program_size.py:406, :424 and :438 fail if the zero-marker, uniform-column or foreign-checkout refusals regress — the last being the failure actually hit through the stale compilation cache — and the receipt and force-added figure are committed although PNGs are gitignored.
justifications.evidence: the counts stand on a recorded measurement (300.json cites job 1272930's 345.483 s compile and 692,225 instructions, logged under /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/reports/nova/s19-local/marker-census-rebaseline/) and I reproduced the census tests independently in this worktree (8 passed, EXIT=0, log at /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20260917T145020377827-review-of-msc-marker-census-rebaseline/review-tests.log), but the derivation's program-identity sentence is measurably false, so one recorded claim is untrustworthy as written.
justifications.fit: the additions reuse the module's own vocabulary and layout (benchmarks/solve_program_size_gate.py:625 renders the report as its receipt and figure writers do) and introduce no plan-stage or version label in any name, file or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: all four asks are landed and inspectable — both sentinel rules tabulated per marker on one dump (docs/figures/millisecond-converged-solve/marker-census/300.json, rows 120/122/444/534 and 79/208/1357/13496), the carried-forward counts and the restatement to 120 and 79 with its derivation (docs/figures/millisecond-converged-solve/marker-census/report.md:40), the synthetic-HLO refusal tests (tests/test_solve_program_size.py:406, :424, :438) and the module gate's zero-added result in the source manifest; one support sentence in that derivation is false as written, so not full marks.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only ad2c5ee1..HEAD lists exactly the seven declared paths and nothing else — benchmarks/solve_program_size_gate.py, tests/test_solve_program_size.py, docs/plans/millisecond-converged-solve.html, docs/evidence/archive/millisecond-converged-solve-landed.html, and the three files under docs/figures/millisecond-converged-solve/marker-census/.
